adjudication.rationale: The diff shows refreshOAuthTokens.ts at lines 6-14 making a fetch call to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT without any timeout, AbortController, or signal. This is a real defect - if the external credential sync service accepts a connection but stalls (slow loris attack, network issues, service hang), the fetch will block indefinitely. This affects all calendar/video integrations that use this function (Google Calendar, Office365, Zoom, Webex, etc. as shown in the diff). The lack of timeout is a genuine reliability/availability bug that could cause request handlers to hang.
